criteria.text: The nightly price sync completes green on a real GitHub run after the fix (Chromium installed; a cancelled run also notifies Telegram).
Section regeneration prices its LLM call at the call; regeneration_history.cost_usd is the recorded cost, never a placeholder 0.
The seven February TODO markers are gone from src: each implemented or replaced by a recorded decision.
Jina spend in quality-validator.ts and semantic-matching.ts is attributed to a course; RETRIEVAL_DEFERRED is empty and no-anonymous-spend is green.
An upstream PR to docling-project/docling-mcp for issue #134 is open and its URL is recorded on mc2-vlskb.

The Helixa branch is delivered to develop with the six triggers reviewed, its migrations applied to the shared dev/staging database and to production, and a Helixa-side handoff prompt written to a Markdown file.
pnpm type-check and pnpm test:unit are green on develop; a release is tagged and deployed to production.
